title: avenula bromoides subsp. australis
intro: Avenula bromoides subsp. australis, commonly known as Australian oat grass or Avena australis, is a subspecies of oat grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is a perennial grass native to Australia, used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antihistamine properties, making it useful for relieving stress, anxiety, and insomnia. Avenula bromoides subsp. australis contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
